name: update_issue
description: Update an existing Linear issue's fields or labels.

issue.description: The issue to update, as a human identifier such as "STA-123". Required.

description.description: Optional. The new description, in Markdown. Pass an empty string to clear it.

state.description: Optional. The workflow state name, for example "In Progress".

assignee.description: Optional. The assignee's name, or "me" for the account the API key belongs to.

priority.description: Optional. One of: none, urgent, high, medium, low.

project.description: Optional. The name of the project to move the issue to.

due_date.description: Optional. Due date as an ISO date, for example "2026-09-30".

add_labels.description: Optional. Comma-separated label names to add. Existing labels are preserved; only use remove_labels to drop labels.

remove_labels.description: Optional. Comma-separated label names to remove. Other labels are preserved.
